answer: Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, re-queued for a second panel, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. What survives to the saffron is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The ivory is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the oasis. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
